践中如何开展以药物相互作用为切入点的临床药学服务,从而尽可能规避药物相互作用在临床用药中给患者带来的不良后果。结果与结论:临床药师必须深入临床,切实了解实际用药情况,找准切入点,才能与医护人员优势互补,发挥药师专长,提供高附加值的药学服务。Pharmacists' Practice in Carrying out Drug - interaction - related Pharmaceutical Care
ZHU Man, SUN Yan, GUO Dai-hong, LIU Gui-yang(The First Clinical Dispensary, Drug Supply Center, The Chinese PLA General Hospital, Beijing 100853, China)ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE: To provide reference for clinical pharmacists to carry out drug - interaction - related pharmaceutical care. METHODS: Taking the pharmaceutical care encountered by our full - time clinical pharmacists in clinical practice as example to discuss the approach for clinical pharmacists to carry out drug - interaction - related pharmaceutical care so as to avoid the adverse effects induced by drug interactions. RESULTS & CONCLUSION: Only through participating in the clinical work and familiarizing the actual medication and the problems existed can clinical pharmacists achieve advantage compensation with medical staff, make full play of their expertise and provide pharmaceutical care of high added value.临床药学在医院药学工作中的重要性是毋庸置疑的。
